no-ambient-clock.src/**: Only command behavior is pinned by the test preload; src/lib owns the real clock and reads it directly (dates.ts, name-cache, self-update).
no-ambient-clock.test/**: Tests build fixtures and timeouts from the real clock; the pinned day comes from localDay() in test/helpers.ts.
no-ambient-clock.scripts/**: The gates and the mock run on the real clock: the mock stamps created entries with now and no gate output depends on a pinned day.

no-bare-process-exit.scripts/**: exitAfterFlush() lives in the CLI's src/utils/action.ts; the gates are short Bun scripts that print and exit with their own status (risk.ts exits 2).

no-category-name-resolution.test/**: Tests drive category resolution through the CLI or the single owner; fixtures name categories but do not reimplement the lookup.
no-category-name-resolution.scripts/**: scripts/ never resolves a category the user named; the mock answers category requests by id.

no-due-anchor-fallback.test/**: Tests build card fixtures that name proximoVencimento to prove the missing-date behavior; production reads go through card-invoice.ts.
no-due-anchor-fallback.scripts/**: The mock builds card payloads that name proximoVencimento as the API does; only the CLI's card reads go through card-invoice.ts.

no-git-copy.src/**: The rule guards the gates in scripts/ and their tests; the CLI in src/ never parses --base or diffs a branch.

no-host-literal.test/**: Tests pin the host as a literal to prove the owner's URLs, headers and cookie domain; deriving the expected value from the owner would hide a host change.

no-literal-since.src/**: The rule guards fixed dates written in tests; commands read the --since value the user passed.
no-literal-since.scripts/**: The rule guards fixed --since dates written in tests; scripts/ passes no --since.

no-raw-dash.scripts/**: cell() writes the CLI's table cells; scripts/ prints JSON and plain gate reports, not CLI tables.

no-raw-spawn.src/**: The rule guards the gate infrastructure in scripts/; the CLI's own children (self-update, browser login, the import editor) belong to src/.
no-raw-spawn.test/**: Tests drive the scripts as a user does (bun scripts/x.ts) and build throwaway git repositories; scripts/git.ts owns only the gates' children.

no-short-option-equals.src/**: preprocessShortOptions runs only in bin/cli.ts, before commander parses argv.
no-short-option-equals.test/**: Tests exercise the preprocessing through the real CLI (test/cli-short-option-equals.test.ts), not by importing it.
no-short-option-equals.scripts/**: preprocessShortOptions runs only in bin/cli.ts; scripts/ parses its own long flags.

no-tautological-expect.src/**: The rule guards test assertions; src/ has no expect() calls.
no-tautological-expect.test/**: Only test/**/*.test.ts is linted; helpers and fixtures hold no assertions.
no-tautological-expect.scripts/**: The rule guards test assertions; scripts/ has no expect() calls.

no-type-sign-ternary.scripts/**: The mock stores entry values as the request sends them; the sign by type is CLI logic owned by src/commands/entries/type.ts.
